details.description: Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct is a 32.5-billion-parameter (31.0B non-embedding) instruction-tuned chat model from Alibaba's Qwen team, released September 2024 under the Apache 2.0 license. It has 64 transformer layers with grouped-query attention (40 query heads, 8 key-value heads). Compared with Qwen2, Qwen states the 2.5 generation brings more knowledge and stronger coding, math, instruction-following, and structured-data/JSON output, plus improved robustness to varied system prompts for role-play.
advantages: Scores 88.4 on HumanEval and 84.0 on MBPP for code generation, per Qwen's published Qwen2.5 evaluation results.
Scores 83.1 on MATH and 95.9 on GSM8K, per Qwen's evaluation results.
Scores 79.5 on IFEval strict-prompt, an instruction-following benchmark, per Qwen's evaluation results.
use_cases: Code generation and software engineering assistance
Structured data understanding and JSON output generation

sources.title: Qwen2.5-LLM: Extending the boundary of LLMs

notes: Qwen's model card states this model natively supports up to 131,072 tokens of context (extendable with YaRN beyond a 32,768-token base config) and up to 8,192 output tokens. Catalog's facts (32,768 in/out) instead match what Fireworks AI, the hosting provider, itself lists as this deployment's context length ('32.7k tokens', no separate output cap), so the catalog value is kept and the maker's larger extended-context figure is not restated above.
